patch_description: Use count four and radius multiplier 1.25 as the reference policy: its measured mean error was 3.76 versus the current program’s 3.95, although its worst case worsened. Test a modest contraction to 1.1875 when positive fitness loss is matched or exceeded by recent improvement. The hypothesis is that a smaller relocation neighborhood preserves useful concentration after recovery. These observations do not establish recovery causally; the conditional change requires evaluation against the constant four-particle policy.
